name: Unified Lead Router
purpose: Read the processed lead output coming from the 3.2 enrichment and dedup pipeline.
rules: Accept only leads that have passed the preceding 3.2 pipeline.
Preserve all fields required by the scoring path.
Do not score the lead in this node.

name: Map Lead to Ollama Scoring Input
purpose: Map and rename the processed lead fields into the Module 1.4 Ollama scoring input schema.
rules: Preserve lead identity and source metadata.

source_gap.action: Use the exact existing Module 1.4 Ollama input schema.

name: Execute Module 1.4 Ollama Scoring
purpose: Send the mapped lead to the existing Module 1.4 scoring workflow.
rules: Use the existing Module 1.4 scoring workflow.
Preserve the lead identifier and source metadata.

source_gap.action: Select the existing production Module 1.4 workflow.

name: End-to-End Single Lead Trace Test
purpose: Verify one lead can travel from the 3.2 output through routing, schema mapping, and Module 1.4 scoring.

test_data.requirement: Use a real or approved test lead containing the fields required by the pipeline.

verify: Fields map correctly into Module 1.4 schema.
pass_condition: One lead completes the entire 3.2 → 3.3 → Module 1.4 path successfully.
